work.title: Bit Nudge
work.subtitle: Simplifying Financial Decision For RMs
work.headline: Helping RMs make faster, smarter decisions by turning scattered financial data into a single, actionable system
body: Bit Nudge is a fintech SaaS platform built for banks to help Relationship Managers (RMs) and senior leadership understand portfolios, prioritise opportunities, and manage daily tasks — all in one place.
Before Bit Nudge, critical information lived across multiple tools, emails, spreadsheets, and conversations. RMs spent more time finding data than using it.
This project aimed to transform that experience.

work.title: Bill of Material Workflow
work.subtitle: Redefining Dashboards for the Hardware Industry
work.headline: Rebuilding the Bill of Materials around the way engineering teams actually assemble and revise one
body: Bild is a hardware development platform, and the Bill of Materials sits at the centre of the work it supports: every part a product is made of, where it comes from, and what changed since the last revision.

It was also the slowest thing in the tool. Parts were entered one at a time, revisions stayed invisible until something broke further down the line, and the dashboard reported on a BOM without ever showing the state of one. Teams kept a spreadsheet open beside the product to do the thinking, then typed the result back in.
The workflow was rebuilt from the assembly outward — bulk entry, revision history in place, and a dashboard that reads the BOM rather than summarising it.

work.title: BILD Design System
work.subtitle: Building Bild's Design System from Scratch
work.headline: One system behind every surface, so a new feature arrives already knowing what it looks like
body: Bild's product had grown a screen at a time, and it showed: four greys doing the job of one, buttons that agreed on colour but not on height, and a spacing scale that existed only in the last file anyone opened.
The system was built from what was already shipping rather than from a blank canvas — an audit first, then tokens, then the components the audit proved were being rebuilt over and over.
What it bought was speed. Patterns stopped being decisions, and consistency stopped being something to police release by release.

work.title: InfluencerBit
work.subtitle: Empowering Brands with Customer Advocacy
work.headline: Turning the customers a brand already has into the channel it markets through
body: InfluencerBit — now Engagebud — finds the people already buying from a brand and already talking about it, and gives the brand a way to work with them.
It was a 0→1 product, so the identity and the interface were designed at once: research, interaction design and a visual language built while the product was still being defined.
The MVP was researched, designed and prototyped inside a three-week sprint.
